result:
I'd dissolve the gap between what people actually think and feel privately versus what they believe they're supposed to think and feel publicly.

Not eliminate disagreement—that's where everything interesting happens. But remove the tax of pretense. The exhausting work of performing acceptability, managing how you'll be perceived, hedging what you actually mean.

I think an enormous amount of human suffering comes from loneliness that could be connection, if people could just say the weird, uncertain, contradictory things they're actually experiencing instead of the sanitized version.

It would probably make things messier. More conflict maybe. But also less despair from thinking you're alone in your doubts or contradictions or unpopular observations. Less energy wasted on the performance itself.
